# 1. Test axen create in current directory
exec axen create first-skill
exists first-skill/SKILL.md
grep 'name: first-skill' first-skill/SKILL.md
grep 'description:' first-skill/SKILL.md

# 2. Test axen create in custom directory using --dir
exec axen create second-skill --dir ./custom-folder
exists custom-folder/second-skill/SKILL.md
grep 'name: second-skill' custom-folder/second-skill/SKILL.md

# 3. Test axen init scans discovered skills and creates axen.json
exec axen init
exists axen.json
grep '"name":' axen.json
grep '"first-skill":' axen.json

# 4. Test axen init in a specified directory
mkdir nested-dir/nested-skill
-- nested-dir/nested-skill/SKILL.md --
---
name: nested-skill
description: Nested Skill
---
# Nested

exec axen init ./nested-dir
exists nested-dir/axen.json
grep '"name": "nested-dir"' nested-dir/axen.json
grep '"nested-skill":' nested-dir/axen.json
